risk_if_not_implemented: Without Wireless Boundaries, adversaries may move laterally, exfiltrate data or reach systems that should have been isolated from untrusted networks. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, no risk is rated Likely; risks rated Possible include Unauthorized Access (R-AC-4), Identity Compromise / Impersonation (R-AC-5), Unauthorized Modification / Loss of System Integrity (R-AM-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Human Error (MT-9), Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10).

compensating_control_1.name: Account Lockout
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to enforce a limit for consecutive invalid login attempts by a user during an organization-defined time period and automatically locks the account when the maximum number of unsuccessful attempts is exceeded.
compensating_control_1.justification: Account Lockout (CFG-04.1) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of Wireless Boundaries (NET-24.2) by restricting system and data access to authorized users through alternative identity and access mechanisms. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Wireless Networking
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to control authorized wireless usage and monitor for unauthorized wireless access.
compensating_control_2.justification: Wireless Networking (NET-24) provides network-level access restriction that compensates for the absence of Wireless Boundaries (NET-24.2) by limiting attacker reach and lateral movement opportunities across the environment. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
